notes.title: Update 1.03
notes.content:
[b][h1]Version 1.03[/h1][/b]
The most recent update includes the following:
[list][*]Added English language support (still working on localization)You can access it in the options menu.
[*]Added special animation when defeating any boss.
[*]Bookania's skills can no longer be learned without first defeating the level bosses.
[*]Fixed some bugs.[/list]
